video_title: Spurs vs Suns Preseason Shootaround Press Conferences: Tarris Reed Jr and Harrison Barnes

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes on the Spurs' preseason roster and team goals
quotes.excerpt: Can we put together a better 48 minutes than what we've done the first three games?
quotes.quote: Not for us at this preseason point because we're not going to have our full roster until a little bit. Obviously, Fox hasn't played a game yet, Tobias is still coming back. We'll see who's in the lineup tonight. So for us, it's just a matter of, can we put together a better 48 minutes than what we've done the first three games? I think that's more so what we're looking for tonight rather than saying, okay, this is how we're going to start the beginning of the season or Game 1.
quotes.social_post: Harrison Barnes says the Spurs are still waiting on their full roster to return before finding their rhythm. The focus for now is simply putting together a better 48 minutes of basketball.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes on the development of teammate Charles Bassey
quotes.excerpt: He's had a really good summer leading into camp and he's played well in camp.
quotes.quote: I thought he played great. He's actually had a really good summer leading into camp and he's played well in camp, so it was great to see him get some more minutes and get his feet under him. I know those first couple of plays and possessions in the first couple of games, he was like, it's moving a little fast, but it was good to see him settle in and do his thing.
quotes.social_post: Harrison Barnes likes what he is seeing from Charles Bassey this camp. Barnes noted that Bassey has had a really good summer and is starting to settle in on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes on the shooting ability of Charles Bassey
quotes.excerpt: He can really shoot it. His confidence has continued to grow and he's really a good player.
quotes.quote: He can really shoot it. After practice sometimes we always do our little shooting games and the first couple of days I was like, okay, he's shooting that thing a little bit. And then his confidence has continued to grow and he's really a good player.
quotes.social_post: Harrison Barnes is impressed by Charles Bassey's shooting development. Barnes says Bassey has been showing off his range in practice and his confidence continues to grow.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes on the Spurs' need for better game execution
quotes.excerpt: We can't ease our way into games. I think that the start executing the right way.
quotes.quote: It all starts with our preparation but also how we start games. I think that'll be a big thing for us, just making sure that we're starting off on the right foot. Teams are going to be physical, bring the pressure, be on point to start. So for us, we can't ease our way into games. I think that the start executing the right way.
quotes.social_post: Harrison Barnes emphasizes that the Spurs cannot afford to ease their way into games. He says the team needs to be physical and execute the right way from the opening tip.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes on preseason indicators for team identity
quotes.excerpt: I always think that there are indicators early in the season as to what type of team.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say necessarily in the preseason, but I always think that there are indicators early in the season as to what type of team you're going to be. I think when you add a little bit of adversity, then you can see like, okay, are we on to something unique? For example, last year during our in-season tournament run, I thought we were able to put some things together that gave the collective an idea of, oh okay, we can do this.
quotes.social_post: Harrison Barnes believes true team identity is forged through adversity. He points to last year's in-season tournament run as a moment where the group realized what they were capable of achieving.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes on the importance of putting in team work
quotes.excerpt: You still have to put in the work. You still have to put in the collective time.
quotes.quote: I still think you have to put in the work. You still have to put in the collective time. I think sometimes it can be a fallacy to just say, oh okay, cool, we'll just pick up with late-season execution and we're just right there on point. You still have to build every step. You have to do the things that are necessary and I think right now in this preseason, it's important that we get something out of these next two games.
quotes.social_post: Harrison Barnes warns against the fallacy of thinking a team can just flip a switch. He says the Spurs must continue to put in the collective time and build every step of the way.

quotes.speaker: Tarris Reed Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tarris Reed Jr on his rebounding performance and growth
quotes.excerpt: I knew I could have got 20, 25, but I feel like that's part of why I got grow.
quotes.quote: I knew I could have got 20, 25, but I feel like that's part of why I got grow and just keep my foot on the gas. You know, I had like 10 rebounds in like the first eight or 10 minutes, so I could have easily ended up with 20. So being even more persistent, more tenacious on that on that part and yeah, keep keep keep going.
quotes.social_post: Tarris Reed Jr is setting a high bar for himself on the glass. After grabbing 10 rebounds in limited minutes, he says he knows he could have easily finished with 20 or 25.

quotes.speaker: Tarris Reed Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tarris Reed Jr on the influence of his time at UConn
quotes.excerpt: It changed a lot about who I was as a person, who I am as a player.
quotes.quote: It changed a lot about who I was as a person, who I am as a player. So really having that multiple efforts mindset and sticking with that in the NBA, so keeping that with me.
quotes.social_post: Tarris Reed Jr credits his time at UConn for shaping his mindset. He says he is bringing that multiple efforts mentality with him to the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Tarris Reed Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tarris Reed Jr on the difference in spacing in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Everybody's good here, so that's been the biggest difference between here and college.
quotes.quote: Everybody's good here, so that's been the biggest difference between here and college and the spacing. There's a lot more spacing in the NBA and that that can be a good, good and bad thing. So really learning how to how to take up space and also get space because we have a lot of elite guards that can get downhill whenever they want.
quotes.social_post: Tarris Reed Jr says the biggest adjustment to the NBA has been the spacing. He is learning how to navigate the extra room on the floor while playing alongside elite guards.

quotes.speaker: Tarris Reed Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tarris Reed Jr on learning from veteran big men
quotes.excerpt: These are guys I've watched literally in college and it's crazy just going up against those type.
quotes.quote: They have a lot of bigs that I've been growing up watching, you know, like guys like Bamba, Jackson Hayes, Mori Larken, Jaren Jackson. These are guys I've watched literally in college and it's crazy just going up against those type of guys. So really learning, playing up against those type of guys, that competition, talking with the guys on this team, going through training camp, going through practice, picking their brain on somebody like HB that's been in the league for a while, Tobias been in the league for a while.
quotes.social_post: Tarris Reed Jr is soaking up knowledge from Spurs veterans. He says he is picking the brains of guys like Harrison Barnes and Tobias Harris to help his transition to the league.

quotes.speaker: Tarris Reed Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tarris Reed Jr on the challenge of practicing against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Everything just revolves around him, so he's so impactful on both sides of the court.
quotes.quote: Everything just revolves around him, so he's so impactful on both sides of the court, both sides of the floor. It was tough getting over. You got to get that little heart on float on him and been working on my touch around him, but he's so so talented and guys like that are generational.
quotes.social_post: Tarris Reed Jr on the challenge of facing Victor Wembanyama in practice. He calls the Spurs star generational and says everything on the floor revolves around him.

quotes.speaker: Tarris Reed Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tarris Reed Jr on his role and commitment to the team
quotes.excerpt: Whatever I can do to impact the team, whatever my role needs to be on this team.
quotes.quote: Whatever I can do to impact the team, whatever my role needs to be on this team, I'll I'll gladly do it with my foot forward and going at it 110%. Whatever coaching staff asks me and one of the biggest emphasis was rebounding, so that's been the thing that I'm like hey, I go out there and rebound, hope that I could, you know, impact this team and help these guys win, but at the end of the day it's all about winning.
quotes.social_post: Tarris Reed Jr is embracing his role as a rebounder for the Spurs. He says he is ready to do whatever the coaching staff asks to help the team win.
